content:
FINAL ENTERPRISE ACCEPTANCE

Do not mark IVX IA as 100% COMPLETE until every item below is VERIFIED with production evidence.

1. IVX IA CHAT
- Verify 100+ production questions.
- Separate:
  - IVX-specific questions
  - General knowledge
  - Math
  - Real estate
  - REIT
  - DST
  - Tokenization
  - Investor calculations
- Verify correct routing for every category.

2. MEMBER SYSTEM
Verify end-to-end:
- Sign Up
- Email verification
- Phone verification
- Sign In
- Forgot Password
- Session restore
- Logout
- Role assignment
- Owner
- Member
- Investor
- Buyer
- JV Deals
- Tokenized
- No duplicate accounts.
- No duplicate profiles.
- No duplicate CRM records.

3. OWNER QA
Verify:
- Owner Dashboard
- Aura
- Autonomous Dashboard
- Variables
- Credentials
- Admin
- Executive Layer
- Deployment approval
- All owner routes protected.

4. AUTONOMOUS
Verify all engines:
- Investor
- Buyer
- JV
- Tokenized
- Outreach
- Technology
- Executive
- Deploy Monitor
- Self Audit
- Drift Detection
- Enterprise

Confirm:
- Scheduler
- Evidence
- Persistence
- Restart survival
- Dashboard counts
- CRM synchronization

5. MOBILE QA
Install the production APK on a real Android device.

Verify:
- Cold start
- Login
- Registration
- Chat
- Aura
- Reels
- Investors
- Buyers
- JV
- Tokenized
- Notifications
- Logout
- Restart
- Offline recovery

No crashes.
No ANRs.
No blank screens.

6. PERFORMANCE
Measure:
- Startup
- Memory
- API latency
- Battery
- Scroll performance
- Chat response
- Dashboard refresh

7. SECURITY
Verify:
- Owner authorization
- JWT
- Secret protection
- No credentials exposed
- No unauthorized access

8. FINAL PRODUCTION REPORT

Return only:

PASS
PARTIAL
FAIL

for every module.

Do not use narrative.

Provide:
- Production SHA
- Deployment ID
- APK version
- Build number
- Test timestamps
- Screenshots
- Logs
- Trace IDs

Only mark "100% COMPLETE" when every item above is PASS.
